targets.authors: Hodgson, G. M. and Rothman, H.
targets.title: The Editors and Authors of Economics Journals: A Case of Institutional Oligopoly?
targets.evidence_quote: Against this backdrop, we aim to reproduce core aspects of H&R's original study with current data to provide a large-scale and up-to-date picture on the current status of the alleged ‘institutional oligopoly’ in economics publishing.
targets.outcome_quote: The findings confirm the long-term persistence of strong oligopolistic structures in terms of both, author affiliations as well as PhD-granting institutions.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly confirm persistence of the original institutional-concentration finding in newly compiled bibliometric data.

reasoning: Newly compiled author and affiliation data retest the original institutional oligopoly claim; not reanalysis of the original dataset.
